text:
To: All Regional Managers
From: Daniela Ortiz, Logistics Director
Subject: Revised delivery schedule

Following last week's port strike, shipments of seasonal inventory will reach our distribution center roughly ten days later than [1]. [2] Stores that depend on these items for the holiday promotion should therefore review their floor plans immediately. Our freight partner has assured us that the backlog at the terminal is being cleared strictly in order of arrival. The delay is regrettable. [3], it does not affect regular orders, which remain on the original timetable. We are also negotiating with a second carrier so that a comparable disruption would [4] our stores far less in the future. Please direct questions about individual orders to the logistics help desk before Friday.

questions.explanation: 'later than planned' needs the past participle, as in 'than expected'.

choices: Regular stock will continue to be shipped from the secondary warehouse in the northern region.
The affected merchandise includes winter apparel, gift sets, and decorative lighting for display windows.
Several managers have already asked whether the strike could be extended into the following month.
Carriers have been informed that late arrivals will no longer be accepted at the receiving docks after six p.m.
questions.explanation: 'these items' in the next sentence needs an antecedent; only the correct choice names the delayed seasonal goods.
The sentence adds a contrast: the delay is regrettable, but regular orders are not affected.
'Affect' is the verb meaning to influence; 'effect' is normally a noun.

text:
MEMO
To: Finance and Procurement Staff
From: Hyun-woo Park, Chief Financial Officer
Date: March 3

Effective April 1, all purchases above $2,500 must be [1] by a department head before an order is placed with any vendor. The previous threshold of $5,000 allowed too many significant commitments to escape proper review. [2] Requests below the new limit may still be handled through the existing online form. Employees who ignore the procedure will be asked to explain the expense to the audit committee, [3] repeated violations may result in disciplinary action. A short training session on the revised workflow will be held in Conference Room B on March 18. Attendance is strongly encouraged, [4] the system will be unavailable for several hours on March 31 while the update is installed.

questions.explanation: After 'must be', a past participle is required to form the passive.

choices: Department heads have complained that the online form takes far too long to complete during the busiest periods.
The lower threshold is meant to give the company clearer oversight of spending on equipment and services.
Several vendors have offered discounts to customers who place large orders before the end of the quarter.
The audit committee will publish its findings on last year's expenditure at the end of the first quarter.
questions.explanation: The sentence explains the purpose of the lowered limit mentioned just before it and leads naturally to 'requests below the new limit'.
Repeated violations add a further consequence to the explanation; the clause continues the same idea.
The second clause gives the reason attendance is encouraged: the system will be offline from March 31.

text:
NOTICE TO RESIDENTS
Hawthorne Court Apartments

The building's heating system will undergo a scheduled upgrade between October 14 and October 18. During this period, hot water will be [1] between 9 a.m. and 3 p.m. each day. [2] Residents who rely on early-morning showers are advised to adjust their routines accordingly. Engineers will need access to each unit to inspect the radiators, so tenants are asked to ensure that the areas around them are [3]. If you will not be at home, please leave a key with the front desk by October 12. Management apologizes for any inconvenience and is confident that the improvements will [4] energy costs by roughly fifteen percent over the winter.

questions.explanation: Water cut off during set hours is 'unavailable'; the other adjectives do not describe supply.

choices: The new boilers will be delivered by truck on the morning of October 14 and lifted into the basement.
Outside those hours, the supply will operate at normal capacity, and the heating will stay on.
The front desk will remain open during the work and will be able to take messages for residents.
The utility company has announced that gas prices will rise sharply once the winter season begins.
questions.explanation: The sentence completes the information about the daily interruption and explains what happens outside the 9 to 3 window.
'are clear' is an adjective after 'to ensure that ... are'; the adverb or gerund would not fit.
Better heating efficiency would 'reduce' energy costs.

text:
Local Bakery Expands Despite Rising Costs

When Marta Lindqvist opened her bakery on Ferry Street five years ago, she employed three people and sold fewer than two hundred loaves a day. This month, she will open her third location, [1] making Lindqvist Breads one of the fastest-growing small businesses in the city. [2] Flour prices have climbed steadily, and rent in the downtown district has doubled. Ms. Lindqvist says the key to survival has been a simple rule: buy locally whenever possible. By signing long-term contracts with regional farms, she has [3] her supplies at a stable price. She also credits a loyalty program that rewards customers with a free pastry after every ten purchases. [4] she plans to add a small café area at the new store, she insists that baking, not coffee, will remain the heart of the business.

questions.explanation: 'thereby making' links the opening to its result; the participle phrase needs 'thereby'.

choices: Her new location will offer a wider range of sourdough breads than either of the two existing stores.
The achievement is all the more remarkable given the pressures that have hit the industry in recent years.
Most customers say they visit the Ferry Street branch because it is close to their offices.
The city council has recently approved plans to build additional public parking near the downtown district.
questions.explanation: The following sentence lists pressures on costs, so the preceding sentence must evoke difficulty and remarkable growth.
One 'secures' supplies at a stable price by signing long-term contracts.
The clause 'she plans to add a café' contrasts with 'baking will remain the heart of the business'.

text:
Customer Success Coordinator – Brightway Software

Brightway Software, a leading provider of scheduling tools for healthcare clinics, is seeking a Customer Success Coordinator to join its Toronto office. The successful candidate will serve as the primary contact for new clients during their first ninety days. [1] You will walk clinic administrators through setup, answer technical questions, and gather feedback that will be [2] to our product team. Applicants should hold a bachelor's degree and have at least two years of experience in a client-facing role. [3] Experience with healthcare systems is considered an asset, it is not required. Candidates must be able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical staff. We offer a competitive salary, flexible hours, and an annual training budget. To apply, send your résumé and a brief cover letter to careers@brightway.example [4] April 30.

choices: Your goal will be to ensure that each clinic uses the software confidently and without disruption to its patients.
Many clinics have reported that scheduling errors are the most common cause of missed appointments.
Brightway was founded in 2009 and now supports more than three thousand clinics across North America.
Several of our employees have moved to the support team after receiving promotions this year.
questions.explanation: The next sentence begins with 'You will walk clinic administrators through setup', so the preceding sentence must introduce the role's goals.
'will be relayed' is a passive construction requiring a past participle.
'Although' introduces a concession: helpful but not required.
A deadline for sending applications is expressed with 'by' plus a date.
